meta.title: How I Style My Fine Hair. (Men’s Hair Product/Pomade/Clay)
meta.description:
Woah! How I style my hair! Does anyone even care? Not entirely sure.

Want to subscribe? Follow me on ig? (@8thWeekday).

Hello yes, it's me Michael typing this in the year 2021. Today we are looking into how I style my hair and my hairstyle! The CLASSIC shorter on the sides and longer on the top. Also what men's hair product do I use? A pomade? Matte paste? Yes! Especially from amazing brands like Arcadian. Anyways maybe I'll get a tiktok hairstyle soon and figure out how to do a perm or something. That's a joke I think but I can't be so sure. It's a joke though...or is it. It is. I don't even have tiktok you know? It sucks me in and I can't stop watching it so I just decided to delete it.
